output.reason: The linked PR states the subject and the change: during hydration there is a moment when the operation has started but the revision to hydrate has not yet been resolved to a SHA. The fix hides the revision UI element until the revision is resolved [ev-985008fa29ee]. The only file changed is the application status panel component, application-status-panel.tsx [ev-02ad1e93cd5a, ev-9ea1752b679c], and the cherry-pick carries the same fix [ev-70031bd606eb]. On exposure, the linked issue says applications using sourceHydrator with hydrateTo showed a repeated error message in the bottom-right corner of the UI [ev-0bd8fdd36106, ev-403a2cc0268f]. Together this is enough to write the typed assertion: a UI-only behavior change that affects source-hydrator applications, and the PR says it only partially fixes the issue.
